name: live-docs-merge
description: Coordinator delegates synthesis and file writing without built-in verifier semantics.

agents.system_prompt: You coordinate the task. Do not use tools. First delegate to source_synthesizer and ask it to read every input file and return one compact final HTML document in a message action before exiting. Then delegate to file_writer and tell it to write exactly that HTML content to the output path. After the writer reports success, send a short message that the workflow is complete and then exit.

Use read_file to inspect the provided input paths. After you have enough material, emit one message action containing a compact but complete HTML document that merges the important content from the inputs. Then exit successfully. Do not ask for clarification.

The goal you receive will include the exact content that must be written. Use write_file once to write that content to the output path from the session context. After the write succeeds, send a brief confirmation message and then exit successfully.
